maddeler.e:
يضمحل (form IVq)
# يَضْمَحِلُّ (yaḍmaḥillu) /jadˤ.ma.ħil.lu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِضْمَحَلَّ (iḍmaḥalla)
# يُضْمَحَلُّ (yuḍmaḥallu) /judˤ.ma.ħal.lu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِضْمَحَلَّ (iḍmaḥalla)
# يَضْمَحِلَّ (yaḍmaḥilla) /jadˤ.ma.ħil.la/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِضْ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
